headlines.title: AT&T pursues ‘sticky and high lifetime value’ customers
headlines.summary: The carrier is courting converged customers by “removing friction for consumers” and “constructing plans built around simplicity, transparent value, and convergence,” CEO John Stankey said.

headlines.title: T Q3 deep dive: margin pressure and fiber growth drive mixed market reaction
headlines.summary: Telecommunications conglomerate AT&T (NYSE:T) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 5.3% year on year to $32.32 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.65 per share was 7.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: AT&T (T) Stock Price Sinks As Q3 Results Spotlight Debt Tension
headlines.summary: AT&T just posted Q3 2026 results that looked solid on paper, while the stock took a hit. The share price fell 6.5% in the first full trading session after the release, even as adjusted earnings per share printed at about US$0.65 and free cash flow for the quarter came in near US$5b. Investors came into today after a weak month for the stock and then reacted hard to this print.

headlines.title: AT&T (T) Looks Fully Valued Following Earnings And 2026 Guidance
headlines.summary: Fresh off its third quarter report and updated 2026 guidance, AT&T (T) has become a live case study in how earnings quality, not just headline revenue, can shape investor reactions. That earnings update landed in a rough tape for AT&T. The share price fell about 6% in post earnings trading and is now at US$21.91. This feeds into a roughly 14% decline in the 1 month share price return and a weaker year to date share price performance.

headlines.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 21: AT&T Beats Earnings on Strong Fiber Growth, Raises 2026 Profit Outlook
headlines.summary: Today, Oct. 21, 2026, the telecom giant posted record internet additions and advanced connectivity gains, signaling momentum in its capital-intensive fiber strategy.

description: AT&T Inc. provides telecommunications and technology services worldwide. It operates through two segments, Communications and Latin America. The Communications segment offers wireless voice and data communications services; and sells handsets, wireless data cards, wireless computing devices, carrying cases/protective covers, and wireless chargers through its own company-owned stores, agents, and third-party retail stores. It also provides AT&T Dedicated Internet, fiber ethernet and broadband, fixed wireless, and hosted and managed professional services; and copper-based voice and data, Virtual Private Networks (VPN), wholesale, outsourcing, and IP, as well as customer premises equipment for multinational corporations, small and mid-sized businesses, governmental, and wholesale customers. In addition, this segment offers broadband services, including fiber connections, legacy telephony voice communication services, and other VoIP services and equipment to residential customers. This segment markets its communications services and products under the AT&T, AT&T Business, Cricket, AT&T PREPAID, AT&T Fiber, and AT&T Internet Air brand names. Its Latin America segment provides postpaid and prepaid wireless services in Mexico under the AT&T and Unefon brand names, as well as sells smartphones through its stores, agents and third-party retail stores. The company was formerly known as SBC Communications Inc. and changed its name to AT&T Inc. in 2005. AT&T Inc. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
